versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service RoutineControl (0x31), the Dcm module shall check if the SubFunction to the corresponding Routine is supported (see existence of configuration container DcmDspStopRoutine for SubFunction 0x02; DcmDspRequestRoutineResults for SubFunction 0x03). If not, the Dcm module shall send NRC 0x12 (SubFunction not supported).
